Baba Adam’s Mosque

বাবা আদম মসজিদ

Six domes and an inscribed entrance in the village of Qadi Kasba.

Get directionsVisiting information

Plan your visit

Location
Munshiganj Sadar, Munshiganj
How to get there
From Munshiganj town, take a local rickshaw toward Rampal and ask for Baba Adam Shahid’s mosque beside the shrine in Qadi Kasba.
Access and opening hours
Active place of worship. Public visiting hours are unverified. Ask the caretaker about entry outside prayer times and before taking photographs.
Bangladesh Tourism Board · Baba Adam Mosque

Published sources reviewed 20 November 2026.

Bengal Sultanate · 1483

About this place

The doorway inscription dates the mosque to 1483, in the reign of Jalaluddin Fateh Shah. The rectangular prayer hall is divided into bays beneath six domes. Brickwork, arched openings and engaged corner towers link the building to the regional architecture of the Bengal Sultanate. Baba Adam’s tomb stands close to the mosque.

This is a place of worship. Ask before photographing people or interiors, dress respectfully and allow worshippers priority.
